verdict.rationale: Hugging Face has no root llms.txt: the probe returned HTTP 404. It does offer agent-consumable documentation: docs pages are served as raw markdown (index.md returns HTTP 200), an OpenAPI spec sits at /.well-known/openapi.json, and the hf CLI ships a Skill for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt/llms-full.txt index, documentation describing the markdown docs as an agent entry point, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: If you use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another coding agent, install the `hf` CLI Skill — a command reference generated from your installed CLI:
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://huggingface.co/.well-known/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
